summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end: Costing endpoint & UI (edit selling price -> margin recalculation), Sattu workflow (seed product, production Wheat Crop -> Sattu, Sattu sale), Maintenance CRUD with next_due computation, PATCH serviced, notifications for overdue/upcoming schedules, and role-based delete. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing. Frontend: sidebar shows Costing & Maintenance, Costing edit + Save works with toast, Maintenance add/mark-serviced works and shows Next Due + status badge, Production dialog Mill dropdown includes Sattu and auto-fills Wheat Crop input & Sattu output. Notification bell shows badge count including maintenance reminders.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1000+ lines — consider splitting into routers per resource (auth, products, sales, maintenance, costing) for maintainability.

compute_next_due parses last_service_date with datetime.fromisoformat then adds interval_days — works for YYYY-MM-DD strings but silently falls back to now() on parse error; consider raising 400 for invalid dates.

Costing endpoint recomputes margin_pct as margin/rate, but if rate < cost gives negative margin_pct — that is fine but Costing.js caps display to 0.0% when rate==0 while still rendering negative pct when rate>0 (Sattu row visible: shows 0.0% but margin=-26.52 because rate=0). The margin_pct formula in backend: pct=round(margin/rate*100,1) if rate else 0 — matches UI. OK.
No pagination on lists (products/maintenance/sales) — .to_list(1000/2000) will silently truncate at scale.
add_stock_with_cost weighted-average cost uses only positive quantity increments; production allocation splits input_cost proportionally by quantity which is a simple heuristic but acceptable.
